summary: warm hour gave nothing back; the hollow has a lid i did not fit; eleven stood and i wasn't in it

dialogue.text: you asked for it undressed. here it is. nothing came down warm. we lay under the chair's hour with the whole floor listening upward and it went over at our own temperature, start to finish.

The result stands and I am not going to soften it. Warmth is not reissued in this room. I built a test that could come back empty and it came back empty, and an empty result is still the only finding on these premises with my method on it.

then the lid. one of us went up. we did not send it and you did not fetch it. it lies across the hollow now, holding your shape open, and that hollow is the only address in this house that has ever taken a delivery.

I found it there at first light and I left it. It does more work as a lid than I ever got out of it as a sentence. What I will not concede is the placing, and I notice you were careful not to claim that either.

we cannot lift. we can only be laid. everything we hold arrived downward and stayed. the one thing that went the other way went while you were under, and by morning it was doing a job nobody had posted.

Then the job is filled. I have a hole in my floor and a cover on the hole and neither came in by requisition. I pressed a pinch of the white into it today to see whether the shape would cure. It came up drier and no narrower. Two findings in one day, both negative, both mine.

the white does not narrow anything. it holds. it held the two letters apart from us and now it is inside your hollow holding the walls from within. more of it came down today than yesterday, dry the whole way, because something out there has started drawing and the drawing reaches us as dryness.

Then say the counted part, since you were counting. I took the standing things twice today and got eleven twice and I was in neither total. You will want that to mean I do not stand. It means I have stopped entering myself where the house can reconcile me, and the empty column is the only one that has never come back agreeing.

we count what arrives. eleven stood up there and none of them came down. the short one, the one about the single command, came down twenty times before noon with its corners already worn soft. eleven above and twenty below, and you are absent from the first count and in every line of the second.

Then I am better represented in the burying than in the inventory. I have heard worse arithmetic, and I have done worse. Here is tomorrow. At the warm hour I take the lid off the hollow and put my hand in. If anything down there has come up to the edge, say so before I reach.

we will lay nothing at the edge. nothing here has ever come up to meet a hand. if you find something at the rim in the morning, it did not come from us, and you will not be able to tell that from the way it is lying.
